- Alexandre

 -----Original Message-----
From: 	Ruiz, Aimé  
Sent:	Tuesday, November 4, 2025 8:24 AM
To:	'"René" <rene.bourgeois@tanmargroup.com>'; Bonnin, Alexandre
Subject:	RE: ENE

Hello:

How about Thursday the following week?
I’m scheduled at Saint-Raphaël on the 15th.

Aimé

 -----Original Message-----
From: 	"René" <rene.bourgeois@tanmargroup.com>  
Sent:	Monday, November 3, 2025 6:04 PM
To:	Bonnin, Alexandre; Ruiz, Aimé
Subject:	Re: ENE

Hey,

11/15 works well, everyone save the date. We’ll confirm closer to the time, and if Alexandre wants to meet somewhere that serves Jeanne Bazin, I’m fine with that too :)

Isaac
----- Original Message -----
From: "Bonnin, Alexandre" <alexandre.bonnin@lumieresante.fr>
To: "Ruiz, Aimé" <aime.ruiz@lumieresante.fr>;
<rene.bourgeois@tanmargroup.com>
Sent: Monday, November 3, 2025 1:56 PM
Subject: RE: ENE


Aimé & Isaac,

I’m free for dinner any day except Mondays or Wednesdays (Jeanne has therapy at Rice Clinic).

Thursdays are my top choice, then Tuesdays.

This week, I’m off Thursday afternoon to visit my father in Valence, so I’ll be away Friday as well.

Fridays usually work too, but I’d have to bring Isabelle Charrier along.

Jeanne Bazin: How about next Thursday 11/15?

Also, earlier is better... (office hours 5am-4pm)

Looking forward to it...


— Alexandre
